primary: CV observation Top-1 on eligible train points (GroupKFold(5) by trip)
rule: If the best models are within 0.005 CV Top-1, the final choice among them is made after Phase 5 by CV Top-1 of classifier+HMM; the best by CV Top-1 is the provisional pick for Phase 4 HPO. Otherwise: highest CV Top-1, with CV log loss as tie-break within 0.001.
